rules.text: In an SVG box/card/node, a leading status dot or glyph and the box title must NOT share a centered anchor: never place a left-positioned glyph (small cx) under a text-anchor=middle title — the centered title's left edge runs under the glyph and clips the first letters. Left-align the title (text-anchor=start at x just right of the glyph), or move the glyph above the title row. Applies to every labelled box in flow / architecture / stat SVGs.
